page_note: Pure substrate teaching throughout. The page contains an extended cosmological analogy: (1) the three places of deceit (water, darkness, fire) hidden in the body of the archons above are likened to diseases hidden in a sick man's body, with the Living Spirit as wise physician; (2) the three garments of the Living Spirit (wind, water, fire) by which he revealed himself to the archons are the three medicines; (3) the analogy of a child in the womb wearing seven kinds of garments (marrow, bone, sinew, flesh, vein, bond, skin) — a numbered enumeration that is signature substrate. No dialogue frame, no ecclesial institution, no hortatory address, no polemic. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic-physiological system. Heavy lacunae (71% damage) but no editorial fatigue.
